interviewChallenges.question: How does constrained decoding differ from post-hoc JSON regex repair?
interviewChallenges.idealAnswerKey: Constrained decoding masks out invalid tokens at the logits stage during generation, making invalid outputs mathematically impossible.

interviewChallenges.question: Why does naive fixed-size token chunking degrade retrieval quality in source code?
interviewChallenges.idealAnswerKey: Fixed chunks split functions and classes mid-scope, severing syntactic and semantic relationships. AST-aware chunking preserves semantic units.

interviewChallenges.question: How do you detect and mitigate cascading hallucinations in multi-agent tool chains?
interviewChallenges.idealAnswerKey: Implement deterministic schema barriers between agent turns, verify tool outputs against assertions, and maintain strict token budgets.
